name: Dante, Aenean Initiate scavenges an Aenean Spell
notes: Uses the official Dante starter material progression with a deterministic ten-card reveal.

rulesClauses: Dante, Aenean Initiate materializes over Dante, Prodigal Swain by paying two memory.
On enter, Dante scavenges the top ten cards for an Aenean Spell, puts the chosen spell into hand, and returns the other revealed cards to the bottom of the deck.
